test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Rahul has done __a study of statistics__ that contributed to the research.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"study of statistics"** refers to the collection, analysis, and interpretation of data about populations. (आंकड़ों का अध्ययन)

 
 
• **Example: **The census is a comprehensive** study of statistics** related to the population of a country.
 
 
 
• **"Demography" **is the scientific study of population characteristics, including size, growth, density, distribution, and vital statistics. (जनसांख्यिकी)
 
 
• **Example: **The **demography** of the region shows a significant increase in the elderly population.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the one-word substitute for **"study of statistics"** is **'Demography'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Choreography **(नृत्य-रचना): The art of designing sequences of movements in which motion, form, or both are specified.

 
 
• **Example:** The **choreography** for the dance performance was beautifully executed.
 
 
 
• **Cartography **(मानचित्रण): The science or practice of drawing maps.
 
 
• **Example: **He studied** cartography** to become a mapmaker.
 
 
 
• **Cinematography** (छायांकन): The art of making motion pictures.
 
 
• **Example:** The film's **cinematography** was praised for its stunning visuals.
 
 

2e3:Tc15,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
